title: An item check runs the lookup eval without the word eval
goal: rag.py accepts a second name for its eval command that does not contain the word eval, with the same output and exit code, and the skills and item checks that prove the lookup eval name it, so a sandboxed worker that refuses any command containing 'eval' can run the check as written; a test proves both names give the same result. Answers the SP-fkyrld5h failure: three workers could not run the rag.py eval check of their item and substituted tests.py -k test_lookup_eval_passes.
